title: The Club Sudan band with Henry Glover and Bill Doggett
summary: At the Club Sudan, the old Cotton Club, McRae led a year-long band that included trumpeter Glover and organist Bill Doggett.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
